messages.author: 4719990e9dfe6605
messages.subject: Significant digits for pvalues
parts:
Dear Karl,

I have decided on using a qvalue approach for FDR in our eQTL mapping
study, but have run into a bit of a snag with this approach with
regard to significant digits for pvalues in the R/qtl summary
statements. The problem is that many of my pvalues are below 0.001,
which is the lowest value in the summary outputs. This means that I
end up running my qvalue analysis with many zeros. I know these are
not zeros, so it would be good to get more precise pvalues to
correctly implement the method.

I have tried using the format.pval command on the R/qtl objects, but
cannot figure out how to do this properly, if it is even possible at
all.

Do you know of potential solution?

Thanks a ton,

David

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Significant digits for pvalues
parts:
If you run 1000 permutations, the pvalues are going to be 0, 0.001, 0.002, ... If you want greater precision, you'll need to run more replicates, but there may still be cases where the estimated p-value is strictly 0. For me, summary() gave the full sig figs.

karl
